scope: Two separate failed native XCTest attempts on actual build 9 in iOS 26.5 Simulator. System Photos navigation and loaded public image labels were observed; neither attempt selected a photo or reached transfer, analysis, OCR or persistence.

inspectorAttempt.observedBeforeFailure: Home Library opened the public Photos navigation. Picker pixels and hierarchy were retained; the tree exposed nine photo labels, disabled Done, Cancel and Search.
inspectorAttempt.failure: Source line 36 read an index-bound Image proxy while enumerating labels/frames. XCTest re-resolved index 10 against a later ten-image query and reported no matching element.
inspectorAttempt.interpretation: The live query changed during inspector enumeration; why its image set changed is unknown. The enumeration did not complete or emit its planned JSON listing. This was not the Photos-navigation assertion and is not an established product loading defect.
inspectorAttempt.visualEvidenceAttribution: The retained independent review records viewing the picker PNG and source hierarchy. Loaded thumbnails and lack of visible selections were observed; visual resemblance does not prove asset bytes.

knownLabelAttempt.labelWhitespace: U+202F narrow no-break space before PM.
knownLabelAttempt.failure: XCTAssertTrue(firstMeal.isHittable) failed before the following firstMeal.tap statement. With continueAfterFailure=false, the case stopped before selection.
knownLabelAttempt.failureMeaning: The expected two public label matches were found, but this attempt could not establish a hittable first image. It does not prove why hit testing failed or that the photo could not be selected by another authorized interaction route.

rootReviewedRecordingFrame.attribution: Root viewed the extracted failed-run recording frame. This curator hashes the retained frame without re-extracting or replaying it.
rootReviewedRecordingFrame.observation: Nine loaded thumbnails are visible, including a label-like and two meal-like QA thumbnails on the first row, with no visible selection marks. Pixel resemblance does not prove original asset bytes.

preservation.meaning: These are retained controller observations. Retained-path file equality is distinct from a successful fresh current-container lookup; no new Simulator/container or OS action was performed for this curation.

limits: Neither failed attempt establishes a product photo-transfer/loading fault, successful selection/decoding, Vision/OCR behavior, or a complete meal journey. The source-derived loading-spy checks remain a separate scope.

The planned photo-label persistence steps were not reached. No photo-model, arbitrary-meal, amount/nutrition/clinical, physical offline, accessibility or submission-readiness claim follows. iOS 26.5 cannot exercise the iOS 27 FoundationModels image path.
No private picker identifiers or coordinate taps were used by these attempts. No source fix, selection workaround, retry, data reset, baseline restoration or new execution proposal is adopted here.
Test and host durations are retained observations, not performance benchmarks.
privacy: No pixels, recordings, raw hierarchy text, private absolute paths, account/device identifiers or saved-record contents are copied into the repository. Local references identify selected retained evidence only.
localArtifactReferencesResolution: Resolve from this JSON directory. Evidence remains outside the submission package.
